name: Easy Digital Downloads
couldBuild: A downloadable product type, a cart, a Stripe checkout and a signed expiring download link. The store works by the end of the weekend.
stillMissing: Then the actual business arrives: software licensing with activation limits, recurring payments and their failure modes, EU VAT determined by customer location, refunds, and a gateway matrix. EDD's own add-on catalogue is the honest map of what you would end up rebuilding.
requirements: Digital product type with variable pricing and secure expiring downloads
Checkout with at least one gateway, plus refunds and receipts
Recurring payments including retries and cancellation
Software licence keys with activation limits and remote validation
Tax handled for the jurisdictions you sell into, EU VAT included

alternatives.name: Easy Digital Downloads (free)
alternatives.desc: A complete digital store; licensing, recurring and most gateways are paid add-ons.
